cards.title: 3-leg receiving yards

legs.note: Kalshi: records 25+ receiving yards. DKP lists 20+ and 30+ only; no substitution
DKP rules: stated number of receiving yards or more. Kalshi lists 25+ and 40+ only; no substitution
DKP rules: stated number of receiving yards or more. Kalshi lists 50+ and up only; no substitution

cards.title: 4-leg player props

legs.note: Rules read: DKP resolves Yes at the stated number of passing yards or more; Kalshi at 200+ passing yards. Over 199.5 = 200+ on both.
DKP rules: stated number of rushing attempts or more, so over 10.5 = 11+. Kalshi lists 9+, 12+, 15+ only; no substitution
DKP rules: stated number of completions or more, so over 20.5 = 21+. Kalshi lists 19+, 24+, 29+ only; no substitution

cards.assumptions: Requested thresholds 199.5 / 10.5 / 20.5 kept as asked. Anytime touchdown: venue market is any touchdown scored (DKP: rushing, receiving, return or defensive, passing excluded; Kalshi: at least 1+ touchdowns). Not a combined price.
